stories.title: HARPPA Recalls Nordi Toddler Tower Stools — Collapse and Entrapment Hazard

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
CPSC RECALL: HARPPA Nordi Toddler Tower Stools (~47,000 units)

Collapse and entrapment risk — a child's torso can fit through the openings.

Stop use now. Free repair kit: harppababy.com

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
HARPPA Nordi Toddler Tower Stool on Amazon or harppababy.com (Sept 2023–June 2026)?

Model HANS0002. ~$130. 3 collapses, 2 children injured.

Free repair kit available. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

article.headline: CPSC Recalls 47,000 HARPPA Nordi Toddler Tower Stools — Collapse and Entrapment Risk
